sienna.blurb: Sienna Store & Cafe on Hindustan Park, which grew from a home kitchen into a two-storey Bengali-leaning cafe and store.

tips.expect: An artsy, photogenic space with different sections at different price points: a casual cafe, a main dining room and a pricier upscale section. Reported hours are about 11:30 am to 10 pm.
tips.good: Bengali food presented for a modern palate, and the store is nice to browse.
tips.watch: Costs range from roughly ₹500 (cafe) to ₹3,000 (upscale section) for two, so ask which section you're sitting in.
tips.tip: It is steps from the Hindustan Park pandal, so book or go early on busy evenings.

marbella-s-elgin.blurb: Marbella's at 1-3 Woodburn Park Road, Sreepally, a pink-hued, Instagram-friendly cafe.

tips.expect: A stylish cafe with a photogenic menu and decor. About ₹800 to ₹900 for two.
tips.good: Cakes, coffee and aesthetic plates, in a pleasant setting off Elgin Road.
tips.watch: Marbella's has outlets at Elgin and at Hindustan Park, so make sure you choose the right one.
tips.tip: Close to the Bhowanipore Mallick Bari and Elgin Road cafes.

marbella-s-gariahat.blurb: Marbella's Hindustan Park / Golpark outlet, the cafe's busier Gariahat branch.

tips.expect: A pink-hued, photogenic cafe. About ₹800 to ₹900 for two.
tips.good: Sweet treats and coffee, a few steps from Hindustan Park and Sienna.
tips.watch: It is very busy on weekend evenings, especially during Puja.
tips.tip: A good break between Hindustan Park, Maddox Square and Singhi Park.

the-elgin-fairlawn-kolkata-heritage-hote.blurb: A colonial bungalow built in 1783 on Sudder Street, a hotel since 1936 and long a favourite of writers, musicians and actors.

tips.expect: A heritage hotel with antique furnishings. Your note on this one says to try the hot chocolate.
tips.good: The old-world setting, in the middle of New Market and Sudder Street.
tips.watch: I couldn't confirm cafe timings or whether non-guests can drop in, so call ahead.
tips.tip: Pair it with the Sudder Street cafes next door and a walk to New Market.

craft-coffee-experience-centre-salt-lake.blurb: The Salt Lake FD Block branch of Craft Coffee Experience Centre, a coffee-focused cafe in Sector 3.

tips.expect: A coffee-led cafe with food. Listings put it at roughly ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 for two.
tips.good: Right by the FD Block pandal, so an easy way to rest and refuel during a Salt Lake hop.
tips.watch: Salt Lake gets traffic-heavy at night, so plan the cab back.
tips.tip: Pair with FD Block and Salt Lake's neighbouring blocks.

craft-coffee-experience-centre-ballygung.blurb: Craft Coffee Experience Centre at 26 Ballygunge Park Road, with a high rating among regulars.

tips.expect: A coffee-led cafe with a full menu. About ₹800 to ₹1,500 for two depending on the listing.
tips.good: A good stop on the Ballygunge Cultural and Singhi Park walk.
tips.watch: Seating is limited on busy evenings.
tips.tip: Combine with Ballygunge Cultural Association and Maddox Square.

cobo-calcutta.blurb: An Asian skybar and brewery on Robinson Street, in the Aauris hotel, spread over 6,000 sq ft.

tips.expect: A big, lively bar with three zones: a glasshouse, a semi-outdoor area and open air.
tips.good: The craft beers brewed in-house and the open-air section for a view over Park Street.
tips.watch: Roughly ₹2,000 for two. Puja nights will be packed.
tips.tip: Go for a late drink after the Park Street area pandals.

burger-you.blurb: A low-key burger spot at 7 Sudder Street. Mark Biswas started it in a garage in 2014 and it grew by word of mouth.

tips.expect: Indulgent burgers in a laid-back, backyard-barbecue mood, tucked away next to Raj's Spanish Cafe.
tips.good: The burgers themselves. This is a cult favourite rather than a big restaurant.
tips.watch: It is small and easy to walk past, so look for it next to Raj's.
tips.tip: A cheap, fast bite when you are near New Market or Park Street.

raj-s-spanish-cafe.blurb: A small cafe on Sudder Street with indoor and outdoor seating, serving Spanish dishes and wood-fired pizzas.

tips.expect: A tiny, characterful cafe. Reported hours are 8 am to 10 pm.
tips.good: Authentic-style Spanish plates, a rare find in Kolkata, at friendly prices.
tips.watch: It is small and tables are limited at peak times.
tips.tip: Sit outside on Sudder Street and watch the backpacker world go by.

miss-ginko.blurb: A pan-Asian restaurant on the third floor of City Mart, 169 Rash Behari Avenue.
dishes: Gai Hor Bai Toey (pandan-wrapped Thai chicken)

tips.expect: A big pan-Asian menu with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, plus a dance floor and DJ.
tips.good: The dim sum, sushi and Thai steamed chicken. About ₹1,500 for two.
tips.watch: It is on an upper floor of a mall building and can be loud on weekends.
tips.tip: Handy right on the Kalighat and Ballygunge pandal route.

yours-truly-coffee-roaster.blurb: A specialty coffee roaster at 1 Ray Street, Sreepally, Bhowanipore, with a very high rating.

tips.expect: A relaxed roastery cafe with Italian-leaning food. About ₹1,200 for two.
tips.good: Roasted-in-house coffee, reservations, valet parking and a pet-friendly policy.
tips.watch: It is on the Bhowanipore side, away from the Gariahat cluster.
tips.tip: A good pairing with the Mallick Bari and Elgin Road cafes.
